title: OTP
description: One-time passwords in one box per character, digits or letters, with a pasted code filling them all. Filled, outline or underline boxes, groups with a dash between, and masked for a PIN. Submits one value. Works with Livewire wire:model.

consider.note: Store the code hashed, as you would a password, with an expiry (10 minutes is common), and delete it once it's used, so it works once. Compare with `hash_equals()` or `Hash::check()`, not `==`.
Consider allowing a few tries per code (5 is common) and then asking for a new one, and throttling by account as well as IP: a 6-digit code is only a million guesses.

Each resend is an email or SMS, and SMS is billed per message. Consider one resend a minute and a daily cap per account and per phone number, which also stops people using your form to send texts to numbers they don't own.
